tools.name: infinity_cumulative_dollar_volume
tools.description: How much traded in total: one US sector's, or the whole US market's, dollar volume (trading volume in US dollars) summed over a range of sessions, by default the last 20, with the average per session and the latest session's figure. Totals only: no prices or price changes.

tools.name: infinity_most_traded
tools.description: The most traded US companies: names and tickers ranked by dollar volume (trading volume in US dollars) for the latest session or the last 5 or 20 sessions, top 10 by default (at most 20), each with a link to its page on InfinityVolume. Names and rank only: no prices and no per-company figures.

tools.name: infinity_search_companies
tools.description: Look up a US-listed company by name or ticker: returns its market and ticker (market:ticker) and a link to its page, for use with the other tools. Names and tickers only: no prices.

tools.name: infinity_find_research
tools.description: Find up to 5 public articles of research published on InfinityVolume about a topic, a company or ticker, or a sector: each one's title, author, date, the companies and sectors it covers, a one-sentence summary and a link to read it. Never the article itself, and no prices.

tools.name: infinity_market_totals
tools.description: Dollar volume by country or market: the total trading volume in US dollars of each of the 13 stock markets InfinityVolume covers (or one), for the latest session or the last 5 or 20 sessions, with the latest session versus normal, each market's share of global dollar volume and what the total covers
